thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - Autoscaler failing to acquire GPUs in `us-central1` (central1). Queue length for inference service `redwood/hosted-gen` spiked to 9.2k. Please respond on-call. :rotating_light:
marisol: I'm on it. seeing a lot of 'QuotaExceeded' and 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED' error lines in the deploy logs. queues growing, customer error rates climbing.
deepak: Confirmed. Autoscaler logs show repeated 403/QUOTA errors from GCP when requesting nvidia-t4 attachments. snippet: ```2026-03-15T16:02:11Z ERROR autoscaler: nodeProvision failed: quotaExceeded: requested 24 GPUs, available 0```
oliver: The pool is exhausted in central1 — we hit regional GPU allocation cap this morning. Cloud console shows no spare quota and pending quota requests were still in REVIEW.
marisol: Impact: ~12% of RPS is failing with 429/503 during peak. Several paying customers reported latency spikes in the last 20m. customer-impact tag: partial degradation.
ash (sre-oncall): tagging runbook: gpu-quota-exhaustion. Steps: 1) reroute low-priority traffic to other regions 2) enable degraded-model fallback 3) request emergency quota.
nash (sre-oncall): I'm triggering the routing rule now to divert non-enterprise traffic to us-west2 for 30m. @deepak please confirm compatibility with model variants.
deepak: reroute in progress. added route: `route: region=us-west2 priority=low` — will take ~45s to warm. Also starting a fallback to smaller quantized variant for non-enterprise tenants: `model: redwood-gen-q4_0`
nash (sre-oncall): 👍 monitor token cost/latency.
nash (sre-oncall): posting to status: "Partial service degradation in us-central1 for text generation, routing some traffic to us-west2. Investigating GPU quota limits."
ajanet: I'm drafting a customer note for accounts seeing 5xxs. Will include ETA for mitigation and note that enterprise customers on Dedicated are unaffected.
nash (sre-oncall): marisol, can you attempt a quick capacity bootstrap to warm spare CPU-backed nodes and serve a low-quality fallback for critical requests?
marisol: Kicking off cpu-fallback job now: `kubectl apply -f cpu-fallback-deploy.yaml --record` — instances should register in ~2m. This will reduce 5xxs but latency will increase for fallback traffic.
oliver: Also opened a ticket with GCP support (case 123456789) requesting immediate quota bump. I pasted quota request payload and marked as urgent.
deepak: While we wait, doing aggressive queue shedding for best-effort customers. policy: `max_queue_time=10s drop=true`
marisol: Observability: queue length peaked at 9200, now down to 6100 after initial reroute. Error rate trending down from 12% to 8% for impacted endpoints.
nash (sre-oncall): Good. Can someone try to spin up smaller GPUs across regions as extra headroom? e.g., a mix of A100 small and T4s in us-west2 and europe-west1?
oliver: Provisioned 12 T4s in us-west2, 8 in europe-west1. Autoscaler accepted them. They show nodeReady=true. Spawning pods now.
nash (sre-oncall): Reminder: keep enterprise traffic pinned to central1 (dedicated pools), don't reroute enterprise until we confirm quota cleared.
ajanet: Customer comms ready. Sending to impacted list: "We're aware of degraded generation in US Central due to cloud GPU quota limits. We're actively routing traffic and enabling fallbacks; ETA 30-60 minutes."
marisol: Received a noisy alert about scheduler backlog. I'm restarting the autoscaler process to clear transient states: `systemctl restart redwood-autoscaler` — will watch logs.
deepak: After restart, autoscaler now reports: `attempting allocation: region=us-west2, gpus=12 success=true`. Central1 still returning quota errors.
marisol: logs: ```2026-03-15T16:09:02Z WARN autoscaler: allocationFallback: central1 quota exhausted, falling back to us-west2```
nash (sre-oncall): Good fallback behavior. Continue to monitor SLA impact. Who wants pager handoff if this drags? I'm scheduled for 2 more hours.
oliver: I can take handoff in 30m if this persists — switching to follow-up.
ajanet: FYI support queue: top 3 customers reported by Ashley — sending targeted notes and offering to route traffic to Dedicated instances if they'd like immediate mitigation.
nash (sre-oncall): Update from GCP support: got a response, case escalated to quota team. No ETA but they've prioritized. They asked for usage traces which I uploaded.
deepak: Additional mitigation: enabling token-level circuit breaker for long requests >8s to prevent backlog storms. Patch applied.
nash (sre-oncall): Queue now at 2400 and falling. Error rate ~3.2%. CPU-fallback serving ~7% of requests.
marisol: Preparing postmortem checklist: collect autoscaler traces, quota request timestamps, reroute logs, and customer-impact timelines. Will open follow-up incident with severity tag and owners.
ajanet: Sending updated customer note: "Mitigations in place; most traffic rerouted or served via fallback. We're working with GCP for quota increase. We'll send an update when quota is granted or service fully restored."
oliver: Filed infra retrospective ticket to add emergency hot-pool across regions to avoid single-region cap exposure. Link: <https://rwd.internal/tickets/INC-2048>
nash (sre-oncall): OK team — continuing monitoring. Handing off to @oliver in 30m unless central1 quota is lifted earlier. If anyone sees regression re-pager immediately. :thumbsup:
nash (sre-oncall): closing loop with severity: P1-> mitigated-> partial-degradation. Followup owner: marisol for postmortem and oliver for infra changes.
